# Community code of conduct

We welcome people who want to improve user-owned decision memory. Participants should treat one another respectfully, explain disagreements constructively, and focus criticism on ideas and behavior.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate of different experience levels and backgrounds.
- Give clear, useful feedback and acknowledge uncertainty.
- Respect personal data, private conversations, and attribution.
- Keep discussion relevant to the project and accept maintainer moderation.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory abuse, sexual harassment, impersonation, and deliberate publication of another person's private information are unacceptable.

## Scope and moderation

These expectations apply to project issues, pull requests, discussions, and other project-maintained spaces. The maintainer, [@david3xu](https://github.com/david3xu), may edit or remove inappropriate content, close discussions, or restrict participation. Responses should be proportionate to the behavior and its impact.

## Reporting

For a non-sensitive project concern, open an issue and identify the behavior without publishing personal details. A dedicated confidential conduct-reporting contact has not yet been established; do not place sensitive reports in public issues. GitHub's platform reporting tools are available for abuse on GitHub.

Security vulnerabilities use the separate [security reporting process](SECURITY.md).
